loss.B: actual number of original business rows in the effective batch, including the last partial batch
loss.tool_supervision: true tool rows only; denominator is all original rows, not only tool rows; do not divide each tool row by 1.75
loss.weighting_note: matches previous loss convention; tool rows intentionally carry an extra supervised objective, so equal row exposure does not imply equal total loss weight

sampling: every row once in each independently shuffled epoch; final partial batch weighted by actual rows; no oversampling
stop_policy: 200-step diagnostic is not early rejection; complete up to two epochs unless nonfinite loss, runtime failure or user pause; no automatic extension; no passing selection means stop without calibration/final

calibration.usage: after development selection only; action NLL temperature, then largest accepted coverage with >=95% observed accuracy and zero human misses/false refusals/unavailable retrieval; defer unexecuted; zero accepted rows is not success

final: after candidate and calibration freeze, one fixed evaluation of candidate and same-preparation base; no selection or retraining from final errors
pre_run_requirements: implement new-contract executor and independent review before changing training_enabled
report training cohort imbalance; no claim this is real service traffic
50-step training-only fresh-adapter probe, discarded afterwards; measure time and memory; then fresh-seed official-base main run
no labels, predictions or error examples from development/calibration/final in training inputs or losses
review crash-safe checkpoint, pause and resume; one GPU owner
uncertainty: report raw denominators, Wilson intervals and story-group bootstrap; synthetic variants are correlated; no deployment claim from high score
comparison: new same-prompt base required; old V5/Qwen/Jev numbers are historical and not a matched baseline
scope: text-only decision component; no learned tool arguments, backend calls, retrieval connector, deployment or multimodal claims
